name: 毒姥
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single definitive front-standing pixel-art boss reference for the same wuxia ARPG. First reference image is approved environment/style mother, second is approved current boss to match coarse pixel cluster size/proportions/dark outline. Create exactly ONE new boss full-body, 45degree orthographic 3/4 top-down camera, facing viewer DOWN. Same muted16-bit pixel art, simple flat two-step hard shading, upper-left light, one native pixel own-material dark outline, <=16 opaque colors. Deliberately low resolution enlarged in output, NOT a high-resolution painting. Genuine transparent alpha background, no ground shadow, scene, text, panels or watermark. Centered full figure with generous margin; no object/limb cropped. Two distinct feet/shoes visible planted on EXACT SAME horizontal groundline, root midway between soles, no perspective foot sitting lower than other. Static neutral boss stance only, no FX or charge motion.
Subject: a hunched elderly CHINESE female poison master about75, slight crooked back and wide grounded robe silhouette, lined ordinary human Chinese face with sharp tired eyes, gray hair wound into a low old-fashioned bun, no pointed witch hat or Western hooked nose. Long ink-black robe #15121A with dark-purple simple cloth bands #4A2A6B and thin poison-green edging #7BE38A, wide dragging sleeves. Her visible thin fingers have small long pale-dark nails. She supports herself on ONE GNARLED WOOD STAFF carved with a coiled SNAKE near the top, staff grasped beside her body, stafftip on same footline. Belt holds three tiny brown clay jars and one small gourd. Simple straw or dark cloth shoes visible below robe. Compact53ish-pixel-tall character silhouette after native reduction (about1.2x the41pixel players), screen width <=53 native pixels including staff. No giant staff taller than needed, no skulls, hood, fangs, horror gore or shield. The poison shield is a separate later asset, do not draw it. Preserve full human silhouette and readable staff/jars in64x80 native canvas.
